overview.description: The iShares iBonds Oct 2036 Term TIPS ETF (IBIM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund tracks a market value-weighted index of US Treasury inflation-protected securities maturing between January and October 2036. The fund will terminate in October 2036 IBIM was launched on Mar 25, 2026 and is issued by BlackRock.
